lead.headline: Sadiq's injury has a name: his back
lead.deck: Your only tight end was limited Wednesday. Andrews is a free agent if he sits. And the flex was flipped to Tuten overnight; put Downs back.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq, the only tight end on this roster, is on the Jets' official Wednesday report as limited with a back injury — yesterday it was undisclosed. No bench player can cover the slot, so the plan stays on the wire: if he is ruled out Friday or inactive at 09:30 Sunday, add Mark Andrews, who cleared to free agency overnight and costs no priority, and drop Carnell Tate. The other item is self-inflicted and small. At 03:31 the flex went from Josh Downs to Bhayshul Tuten. ESPN prefers Downs by a point; that is a coin flip, and coin flips go to the projection. Downs locks at 07:30 Sunday in London. Team 13's DeVonta Smith and Rachaad White both missed Wednesday.

players.caption: Benched overnight; the projection wants him in.
